scope: The 153 previously unchecked source records, their cited claims, county-office roles, and linked portal descriptions. Amador Recorder was separately corrected because its shared URL hid a wrong office role.
limitations: Source-content review is not a browser interaction test or uptime guarantee.
Official indexed content or official referrals were used where direct fetching was blocked, failed, redirected, or returned a JavaScript shell. A retrieval failure does not prove a dead link.
Private property portals were reviewed only for their stated purpose and separation from official listings. No bids, payments, registrations, or transactions were tested.
Cornell legal text was cross-checked with official IRS, TREC, or Nevada guidance for the material claims reviewed.
This review does not certify every website statement or production system as error-free.

additionalCorrections.decision: Real-property recording belongs to Recorder-Clerk, not the Assessor.
Qualified eligible service area, insurer denial and certificate exceptions; retained separate flood coverage.
Qualified ownership/use tests, prior exclusion timing and joint-filer conditions.
